# IBombRules.DropOffset property

How much further behind its runner it is dropped than in the game, in level units: 0 by default. The game drops it 25 units behind a runner facing right, and across the back of a runner facing left. Below 0, it is dropped further ahead.

```csharp
public float DropOffset { get; set; }
```
